verdict.rationale: Featurebase explicitly positions itself as a way to 'centralize insights to a single source of truth' through a feedback portal, in-app widgets and integrations. It also offers AI-assisted decluttering of feedback, and its API returns all feedback posts for an organization. That covers the core of a single feedback repository. missing for 10: explicit evidence of search/filter within the feedback repository, explicit support for internal colleague submissions alongside customer feedback, independent or hands-on corroboration.
